subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should this broader agent-runtime plus Tavily repair be the canonical landing path instead of the narrower open Tavily-only PR?
rationale: Both branches are proof-positive and overlap on Tavily, but only this PR also changes the shared agent Tool Search runtime-config boundary; selecting that broader ownership scope is a maintainer choice.
